+messages across threads in the authenticated sender's current workspace and
+chat, using the already bound profile. Tool arguments expose only keywords and
+a result limit. The model cannot choose a user, channel, database or profile.
+Shared-channel recall never reads private profiles or another channel. A direct
+DM may recall earlier threads in that same DM. Isolated account workers cannot
+use recall; their supplied task context remains their conversation boundary.
